test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Five students A, M, C, Y and G are sitting around a circular table facing outside the center not necessarily in the same order. M sits to the immediate left of A and to the immediate right of G. Y is not an immediate neighbour of A. Who sits second left of G?
solution:
As per the given information:

1. M sits to the immediate left of A and to the immediate right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17b4abf88286eeaf010c6d8ff48f2210a0a8317559821d4f400f0cd6809b9175.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5002ab275cedd3969b4a9590afaf26f57ade0ae1377fd35fc06bcc44869d29f.png] 

2. Y is not an immediate neighbour of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/762b1d4ba81f15c887d24b808902f90f94121666e123448a97026c251ad8164d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61ff3373ac20d853c04ab6d38d5b63d3cbe8afa50ba96b02345cd0dc1bdd0bd1.png] 

Here, **C** is sitting second to the left of G.

Hence, the correct answer is "C".
